releases.displayName: Console Release Date & Major Update Details!

items.text: Hello dog fans! 👋🐶
We've got lots of news to share with you, so let me begin.
Hidden Dogs is coming to Switch, Xbox and PlayStation on 7th and 8th October!
Xbox - 7th October
Switch & PlayStation - 8th October
Play Hidden Dogs from the comfort of your couch!
This is a massive, exciting milestone for Admiral Egg Games.
We can't wait to get you all playing on console.
Our final update is coming 1st October, and it's a BIG ONE!
We're adding new game modes to Hidden Dogs!
Quick Dogs - Play 3 scenes in sequence. You have 60 seconds to find all the dogs in a scene, then you move to the next scene! Reply to get your personal best time!
Rando Dogs - Hard Mode! Play 3 randomly selected scenes, with random sets of dogs. A new challenge every time you enter the level!
Completing Quick Dogs and Rando Dogs will get your a shiny Gold Dog trophy. 🏆
Share your fastest times on our Discord channel!
Finally, we have...
Community Dogs - Your dogs, in our game! Play secrets levels with your pets! 🐕
We're building our community on Discord!
This month,
You sent us your pet photos! Now, we're adding your pets to Hidden Dogs! 🐕
Our community decided which level to add your pets to - the Greenhouse! 🍃
We asked for playtest volunteers for our new major update! 🎮
We reduced our price by $1! 🪙
This brings us in-line with other hidden object games, and will help sales of our console release.
For this who bought at our higher price and feel frustrated by the price drop - please join our Discord and message me, I shall sort it out! ☝️
In England, our nights are darker, the air is colder, and things are starting to get spooky...
We've got something cooking. You'll hear about it soon...
I'm very excited! What could it be?! 👻🎃
Thank you all for playing! If you enjoy our game, please take a second to leave a Steam review.
Chris
Hello dog fans! 👋 Here's a patch for you!
This one improves the zoom in our game - you can now see more of each level! 🔍
We also added a zoom-out on the map, so you can easily see how much of the game is complete. 🏅
Oh, and we've released a new Discord server! 🎉 Join us!
👉 https://discord.gg/vKSGvrqucE 👈
Win prizes!
Share you pet photos!
Chat with the developers, and give us feedback!
Sign up to playtest new features!
Perhaps your dog will be picked to star in a Hidden Dogs level?!
Chris 🐶
All levels now zoomed out by default.
Map screen has a zoom out option, which shows the entire map!
Discord, Instagram and YouTube icons added to the Quit menu.
Cats eyes now highlight fewer dogs.
Winter intro cinematic is now faster.
Fixed an issue when collecting the No Whistle achievement.
The Dog Dialogue closes when pressing Esc or clicking the Options cog.
Hello dog fans! 👋
Here's a tiny patch with lots of small changes that make the game better.
I'm in the middle of a nice big patch that will add a new mode to the game. Stay tuned!
Chris 🐶
The first level of Biff's Pub area is now the Pub Cellar.
When using the whistle on the last few dogs, the camera will focus on a dog.
Our Level Victory animation now has more juice!
The intro cinematic is now faster, and focuses on an area of the game when finished.
The Winter DLC icon is now faded when disabled.
Adjusted the colour for Story Mode icon.
Options menu tweaked.
Reduced the number of dog barks playing during the title theme.
Moved the flight path of a hot air balloon, so it doesn't appear on the title screen.
Fixed a game breaking issue when finding the magnifying glass too quickly in the tutorial.
The introductory dog dialogues will no longer appear in levels.
Stats UI would appear in levels after resetting the game, that's fixed!
Responsibility for the cooldown timing of the hover sound effect is now with FMOD.
Frequently used sounds (dog barks) are now tied to a single audio instance, so makes fewer duplicate sounds barks will appear!
Fixed the cats eyes hiss still playing when leaving a level.
Hello dog fans! 🐶👋
Bad news. Our dog-based video game has been invaded... by CATS! 😼
Those pesky felines get everywhere! They won't leave us alone... 😾
Find them in levels, and poke them to get rid of them. 👉👁️
Find enough, and you'll earn one of our new achievements! 🏅
Thanks again! We'll be back with more free content updates soon!
Oh, and if you enjoy, please leave a review! 🥰
Chris
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352048/24f9f37928370e1a7ef6ce1482f5d231e688e93c.gif"]
Each level now has cats eyes. Poke them for a free hint!
Whistle is slower to refresh.
\ 5 new achievements!
\ 3 achievements for poking cats. 😾
\ 1 achievement for completing a level without the whistle.
\ 1 achievement for switching to English (Dog) language, and speaking to a dog!
UI colour in level tweaked for clarity.
\[Winter Wonderland] Added a silly sound to Shep's first dialogue.
Fixed an issue with the Story Mode toggle.
Fixed an issue with the Winter Wonderland DLC toggle.
Hello dog friends and followers! 👋🐶
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Today, we've got a big patch to share.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Our patch adds; a new tutorial level, new achievements, and an improved story mode! 🎉
[p align="start"]Along with many, many small improvements!
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]We've got more coming, and future patches will focus on new, free content for Hidden Dogs! 👀
Thank you - and please leave a review if you're enjoying our game! 👍
Chris
[p align="start"]We've added a brand new micro level - the Kitchen!
[p align="start"]The Kitchen includes a tutorial for new players.
[p align="start"]The Kitchen is in Guide's house. Returning players can play with the Kitchen as a normal level.
[p align="start"]There are 4 new achievements for completing the tutorial level.
[p align="start"]For returning players, if you completed the tutorial before, you'll automatically get the new achievements!
[p align="start"]We've improved how our story is delivered, and given you an option to play without the story.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Story Mode - On!
On each area unlocked, a dog dialogue will pop up.
All dog dialogues will appear automatically when unlocked!
[p align="start"]Story Mode - Off.
No dog dialogues will appear, just find the hidden objects.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Note: For the final, 'Complete The Game' achievement, you always need to click the last dog dialogue!
[p align="start"]Our title screen now has links to our Instagram and YouTube channels, follow us for updates.
[p align="start"]Press Esc while on the map to access the menu!
During a level, a chime sound effect plays when all dogs or items are found.
The total number of items in a level is now shown.
When on the map, pressing Esc goes to the title screen
Guide's information pop-ups are now clearer and more tidy.
A help button has been added (press Esc while in a level), this brings up all Guides information.
Admiral Egg Games splash screen now plays on game start.
When entering a level, the map music now fades out.
After finding all the hidden objects in the game, a cutscene will focus on final dog dialogue.
The Village Fete cutscene has been improved with sound.
Fixed an issue where item descriptions in different languages would not load their font.
Improved font loading, which will smooth UI transition.
Hint system updated.
Whistle improved.
Longer text will now displaying correctly, and not go beyond its background.

items.text: Hello dog fans! 🐶
We've been busy improving our map!
The map has always got your from level to level, but the experience wasn't as great as it could be...
So we simplified things.
Introducing - the Map Rework patch!
Map Improvements
Locks & Keys - Levels no longer require keys, only Areas need a key to unlock!
Visual Updates - Visual improvements so map icons (levels, dog dialogue and flags) are clearer.
Inactive Icons - Added 'Inactive' icons to the map. Upcoming levels and dialogue are now visible.
Map Progress - After exiting a level you see the old state of the map, then changes pop into view.
Some icons have been recoloured.
Icon placement has been adjusted for clarity.
Added 'Area Unlock' cinematics.
Added a 'Unlocked the Village Fete' cinematic.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352048/b1205068b6aae87804e40a2538f64209a617add2.gif"]
Snow has been has been cleaned up!
DLC does not automatically turn on at the start of the game.
Whistle lasts a little longer when finding the last few dogs.
Fixed a stutter when the UI first appears on 'Start' of the game.
Fixed performance issues caused by the transport moving around the level.
Hello all! 👋
We're back with a very important update - for the first time, Hidden Dogs is providing non-human accessibility options!
English (Dog) allows the game to be played by your favourite pet - the Dog!
English (Dog) Mode
Switch language to English (Dog) for a fully translated, dog friendly experience.
All dog dialogue and item names have been meticulously translated by a pack of well trained translation pups, for a truly immersive experience.
Bugfixes & Polish - Base Game
15 new mutt sounds added!
Drag controls improved on the map, and in levels.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352048/1d0bd7120ec71285ed0d6179d73536fda032250f.gif"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352048/28c6886d619039a5d71f3dc2382d281a995cec7e.gif"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352048/5fa3c6b0e660a1740ce3488c6ec7d0a4ae6e1da8.gif"]
Hello all! 👋
Yet another micro-patch! Polish polish polish! 🐶
Sound Mix!
Mixed the sound for music, sfx, dialogue... well, everything!
Bugfixes & Polish - Base Game
Dog Dialogue - added cooldown to stop accidentally clicking through the first line of dialogue.
Dog Dialogue - Adjusted speed of auto-progress.
Dog Dialogue - Music slightly muted while in a dialogue.
Intro cutscene - Added pop sounds on show of icons.
Intro cutscene - Blocked clicking while cutscene is in progress.
Added hover and click sounds to the Options button.
Fixed bug with stats labels not setting to 0
Disabled zooming on the map.
Hello all! 👋
Here's our latest small patch! More polish to the base game, including a tidy of our music! 🐶
Music Refresh
Extended the duration of music tracks in all levels.
Tidy of background SFX in all levels.
Font Refresh - New Number Font
New font for all numbers.
Tidy of all UI elements which include numbers.
Map Tidy
Tidy of elements on the map: clouds, flags, transport.
Bugfixes & Polish - Base Game
Clearer dog dialogue, with additional animation.
Hello all! 👋
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Here's our latest major patch! We've been polishing the base game and adding some secret content for reveal later in the year! 🐶
Fade out at edges of levels improved.
Level bounds improved.
New fade animations play when loading levels and the map.
Exclamation marks no longer spawn in random locations, the closest to the middle of your view will spawn first.
Exclamation marks now spawn and disappear quickly when many hidden objects are in the scene.
Added whistle marks to the 'shape dog' puzzles.
Screen edge marks improved. They are larger and have a pulse animation.
Tuned the whistle cancel to stop mis-clicking.
Added an icon (top right) in levels to show the status of zoom.
Zoom can be toggled using the icon.
Moved to Unity 6.3.
Dog dialogue can now be cancelled at any time.
Balloons on the map will now rotate!
Colliders improved (all levels), so fewer mis-clicks should occur.
Train trucks will be coloured.
Performance improvements while on the map.
Level description and item description tooltips will scale properly to support longer text.
Improved the title screen cloud transition between Base and Winter DLC.
Music now is effected by changed in the options menu.
Howdy dog fans! 👋🐶
We had a report of a bug in our Winter Wonderland expansion.
This bug stopped the introductory dialogue to Winter Wonderland from appearing. Apologies to anyone effected by this - we've released a small patch to correct it.
Fix for Winter Wonderland introduction dog house not appearing.
Note: Click the dog house next to Guide's House will start the Winter Wonderland expansion! ❄️
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352048/0696be0c01f300b363c50b1ed4f359808ff8f4af.png"]
Hello all! 👋
Here's our major patch, leading up to the Winter Wonderland expansion. 🐶
Intro & Ending
Added an introduction cutscene after exiting the Garden tutorial level.
Added an ending cutscene on completion of the final dog dialogue.
Dog Dialogue
On area opening, the introduction dog dialogue play automatically.
On finding the final item in the game, a dog dialogue automatically plays.
Camera
On game start, if the player is mid-playthrough, camera will focus on the last level accessed.
Tweaks
Tweaks to positions of dog dialogues on the map.
Reduced sizes of ending locks.
Locks open a little faster.
In the background, we've made some big changes to the way the game works!
These changes help stabilize the game, and will speed up patching in the future.
